critique.evidence: Measured results are demo-ready across all three viewports: FCP 52–76 ms, LCP 548–704 ms, TTFB 1.3–5.8 ms, and load/DOMContentLoaded 141–237 ms. CLS is excellent on mobile (0) and desktop (0.0011), though tablet reaches 0.0478. Frame sampling reports no long frames across 82 samples per viewport; worst frame was 33.4 ms on desktop and 16.8 ms on tablet/mobile. There were no console, page, or request failures, and document width matched viewport width. The main performance liability is payload size: 1,314,022 transferred bytes, including 1,148,898 JS bytes, across 17 requests.
critique.fix: Reduce the roughly 1.15 MB JavaScript payload through route-level code splitting, tree-shaking, and deferred loading of non-Atlas screens; then identify and reserve space for the tablet element causing CLS 0.0478. Re-measure interaction frames after filtering and selecting vectors to verify runtime responsiveness beyond the supplied frame sample.
